title: Normalized derived uncurrying from the fixed representative squares
statement: Let $(C,R)$ and $(C',R')$ be small ringed sites with independent universes [def-weil-size-convention], with module categories $\mathcal B,\mathcal A$ and unbounded derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $U:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$ be exact additive, preserving small products and K-injective complexes; write $F=D(U)$. Give it the coherent underived tensor and Hom comparisons preserving canonical evaluation [def-sf-ringed-forget-tensor-transposition-data]. Fix the closed adjunctions and their evaluation-normalized tensor models [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model, lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal]. Fix a tensor-only comparison $m$ with its summand and flat-term K-flat representative squares [lem-sf-ringed-forget-tensor-descent]; assume termwise $U$ preserves flat-term K-flat complexes. Let $\chi$ be the fixed two-injective Hom comparison [lem-sf-ringed-forget-two-injective-hom]. For every $M,K,L\in D(\mathcal B)$ and $f:M\to H_{\mathcal B}(K,L)$, one has $\operatorname{uncurry}_{\mathcal A}(\chi_{K,L}F(f))=F(\operatorname{uncurry}_{\mathcal B}(f))\mu_{M,K}^{-1}$. This is only the normalized uncurrying equation, with the existing tensor comparison as input.

proof.text: Apply the proved representative-evaluation equation to flat-term K-flat P and K-injective I, with the fixed tensor and Hom comparisons. That equation was obtained from actual chain uncurrying, normalized Hom models and the supplied tensor representative square. Use the natural tensor and Hom isomorphisms as the generic comparison data.

For arbitrary derived K,L choose a flat-term K-flat P mapping isomorphically to K and a K-injective I isomorphic to L. Naturality of evaluation and of both comparison isomorphisms transports representative evaluation compatibility to K,L.

For arbitrary M and f, write inverse transpose as tensoring with f followed by evaluation. The generic transposition calculation uses naturality of the tensor comparison and the evaluation equation from the previous step. Apply the target transpose equivalence injectively to conclude the required normalized uncurry identity.

theorem ringed_forget_normalized_uncurry
    (m : TensorComparison.{c, v, r, d, vd, s, wb, wa}
      J R J' R' U u SB TB βB cB SA TA βA cA)
    (_preserves_flat_models :
      ∀ P : CochainComplex (RingedTensorModules.{c, v, r} J R) ℤ,
        P.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients →
        (∀ p : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{c, v, max c v r, max c v r} (R := R) (P.X p)) →
        CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := R')
        ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ∧
          ∀ p : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{d, vd, max d vd s, max d vd s}
            (R := R') (U.obj (P.X p)))
    (M K L : DerivedCategory (RingedTensorModules.{c, v, r} J R))
    (f : M ⟶ (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, wb} J R).obj (op K, L)) :
    (SA.transpose (U.mapDerivedCategory.obj M) (U.mapDerivedCategory.obj K)
        (U.mapDerivedCategory.obj L)).symm
        (U.mapDerivedCategory.map f ≫ χ.derived.hom.app (op K, L)) =
      m.derived.inv.app (M, K) ≫
        U.mapDerivedCategory.map ((SB.transpose M K L).symm f)
